transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because... I've just been trying for months now to get people to understand what's happening. My husband's family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

It's happening in these very specific ways. Like, I'll be at work—I do billing—and these little billing errors will just show up out of nowhere. Or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me, like they've been told something behind my back. And no matter what records anyone pulls up to try and explain it away, I know it ties back to them. I just need someone to finally take this seriously.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others didn't see, during this time?

No, no, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I'm completely in my right mind. It's just... real things happening, like the billing errors I mentioned, or people acting strange. I don't have any hallucinations, if that's what you're asking. I just see what's actually going on.

Before these beliefs about your husband's family started, would you say you generally trusted people and had a different way of relating to others, or have you always tended to be wary and suspicious of people throughout your life?

No, I wouldn't say I've always been wary. I mean... I used to trust people just fine. I got along with everyone perfectly well before all this started. 

I'm not the kind of person who just goes around suspecting people for no reason. It's just... I'm only on guard now because of what his family is actually doing. Before they started messing with my life, my relationships with people were completely normal. I didn't have any reason to doubt anybody back then.
Can you tell me exactly when these beliefs about your husband's family first started, and how long you've been experiencing them?

Well, it's been going on for about nine months now. It all started around the time we had this big disagreement with his family... it was over some money issues and, you know, expectations around the holidays. That's when I first noticed things shifting and the strange stuff starting to happen. So yeah, about nine months.

Aside from these concerns about your husband's family, how have you been managing with your daily responsibilities—like your job, taking care of yourself, and your other relationships—over these past nine months?

I've been managing fine, really. I still get up every day and go to my job as a billing clerk, and I handle all my duties there without any problems. I keep the house running, take care of myself... I even still make time for gardening and a little painting when I can. Everything else in my life is completely normal. The only time there's any trouble or friction is just... well, when I try to warn my friends or my husband about what his family is doing, and they don't listen. But as far as my daily responsibilities go, I'm doing just fine.
